category.name: Email marketing
category.description: Newsletters, subscriber segmentation, campaigns and marketing automation.
category.audience: Businesses, charities and publishers communicating with prospects and customers.
category.audienceRationale: Customer communication spans industries and organization sizes, although primarily used by marketing and business owners.

pricing.note: Essentials displayed $13/month for 12 months at base contact selection; contact and email volume affect price and overages. Free tier limited to 250 contacts/500 sends monthly; Essentials automation limited to 4 flow steps. Verify selected contact count and renewal price before purchase.

oss.name: listmonk
oss.classificationReason: Free self-hosted product; published feature set and API included in open-source distribution. No commercial edition listed. Hosting links are explicitly unaffiliated third parties.
serviceLimitations: SMTP server/provider and PostgreSQL/server infrastructure required; transport limits and deliverability remain operator responsibilities.

health.rsx: Completed; overall score 5.6/10. Shared evidence retained.

oss.name: Mautic
oss.classificationReason: Official pages say self-hosting includes all features and deployment choices do not lock features. Paid managed hosting and extended support are services. Actual LICENSE.txt grants GPL v3 or later despite GitHub NOASSERTION.
serviceLimitations: Self-hosted infrastructure, email transport and operations required. Paid extended support or third-party plugins are separate from core feature access.

health.rsx: Completed; overall score 5.1/10. Shared evidence retained.

oss.name: Keila
oss.classificationReason: Official site explicitly excludes proprietary premium features; cloud and self-hosted use the same software. All hosted plans include all features.
serviceLimitations: Keila Cloud starts at EUR 8/month for 2,000 emails, with unlimited contacts/projects. Self-hosting needs server/PostgreSQL and SMTP or another email transport service. These service costs are not feature locks.

health.rsx: Completed; overall score 6/10. Shared evidence retained.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Newsletter and list-management fit, with segmentation, templates and transactional API. Rebuild Mailchimp automations and integrations; app is focused on one-way campaigns. Import subscribers using CSV/API and preserve consent/unsubscribe status.

Campaign automation, segmentation and forms offer a deeper customization approach. Rebuild journeys and integrations; deployment, cron jobs, email transport and upgrades become operational responsibilities.

Newsletter campaigns, signup forms, segmentation and CSV/API portability. Marketing automation and A/B tests are not yet available per official comparison; smaller native integration ecosystem; rebuild templates and integrations.

uncertainties: listmonk latest GitHub release and homepage identify v7.0.0-beta.1; advertised OIDC/roles/visual-builder capabilities may require this beta. Release tag does not imply production stability.
Keila explicitly lists marketing automation and A/B testing as roadmap items, not shipped functionality; these are product gaps, not paid feature locks.
Hosting and email transport incur operational/service costs; no claim of cost-free email delivery.
